en.headline: Contractors fined up to HK$155,000 over fatal Yuen Long village house demolition accident
en.dek: The Labour Department prosecuted three parties after a female worker was killed when a brick wall collapsed during clearance work in November last year.
body: Cin Fung Engineering Limited, a contractor and Kwan Wai Machinery Engineering Limited were fined HK$155,000, HK$155,000 and HK$130,000 respectively at the Fanling Magistrates' Courts on Tuesday for violating the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance. The prosecutions were brought by the Labour Department.

The case stemmed from a fatal accident on 5 November 2025 at a village house under demolition in Yuen Long. A female worker was conducting manual clearing work outside a brick perimeter wall when the wall suddenly collapsed and pressed against her. She was certified dead in hospital the same day.
The Labour Department said the parties failed to take adequate steps to ensure the safety of workers at the site. The court imposed the fines after hearing the prosecutions.

zh.headline: 元朗拆卸村屋致命意外 工程公司及承建商被罰13萬至15.5萬
zh.dek: 勞工處就去年十一月一名女工在人手清理工作時遭磚牆倒塌壓斃事件提出檢控，粉嶺裁判法院周二判罰三方。
body: 展鋒工程有限公司、一名承建商及鈞威機械工程有限公司因違反《工廠及工業經營條例》的規定，周二在粉嶺裁判法院分別被判罰款十五萬五千元、十五萬五千元及十三萬元。檢控由勞工處提出。
案情涉及二〇二五年十一月五日在元朗一棟拆卸中的村屋發生的致命意外。一名女工在拆卸中的村屋磚砌圍牆外進行人手清理工作時，圍牆突然倒塌並將她壓住，同日送院後證實不治。
勞工處表示，涉案各方未有採取足夠措施保障工地工人安全。法院在聽取檢控後判處罰款。
